fact: Car 41 allegedly left the track and gained an advantage in Turn 2
offence: Alleged breach of Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Cars 41, 27 and 43 were alongside each other going into turn 1 after the race start. Car 41 left the track and rejoined ahead of Cars 27 and 43, subsequently giving back a position to Car 27. The Stewards considered the positioning of the cars before entering turn 1 (i.e. the braking point) and the circumstances under which the cars left the track. They also took into account that the incident happened in lap 1, turn 1. The Stewards determine that no lasting advantage has been gained by Car 41 and take no further action.
stewards: determine that no lasting advantage has been gained by Car 41
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
